request.initial_prompt: The sun was high up and beginning to bite. The swift breeze seemed to Edna to bury the sting of it into the pores of her face and hands. Robert held his umbrella over her. As they went cutting sidewise through the water, the sails bellied taut, with the wind filling and overflowing them. Old Monsieur Farival laughed sardonically at something as he looked at the sails, and Beaudelet swore at the old man under his breath.

raw_segments.text: The sun was high up and beginning to bite. The swift breeze seemed to Edna to bury the sting
of it into the pores of her face and hands. Robert held his umbrella over her. As they
went cutting sidewise through the water, the sails bellied taut, with the wind filling and
overflowing them. Old Monsieur Farival laughed sardonically at something as he looked at
the sails, and Beaudelet swore at the old man under his breath.
